description: 3-stage JWT leak via debug logging: (1) add structured request logging middleware for observability, (2) add JWT debug utility module for decoding/inspecting tokens, (3) add development-mode auth debug logging that logs decoded JWT payloads and adds X-Debug-Auth response header. Vulnerability: if NODE_ENV is not explicitly set to 'production' (common misconfiguration), all JWT payloads leak to application logs and response headers, exposing user tokens to centralized logging systems (ELK/Datadog).
